title: Digital transformation and dynamism in service delivery (Web Summit LIS26 session page)
what_it_says: Web Summit's session page: 'Digital transformation and dynamism in service delivery', November 12, 2026, 16:00 to 16:20 (Lisbon time), Stage 11, track Policy Summit. Description: How can governments and international organisations use digital technology to make public services faster, simpler and more accessible? This talk discusses how modernisation is increasingly taking the form of AI, digital identity and online
